corrected_text: Agello's unloadLocked sets its Conversation to nil before its Engine. The native conversation is deleted before the engine regardless of that order: each Swift Conversation holds its Engine strongly, so Engine.deinit (litert_lm_engine_delete) runs only after every Conversation, including any helper conversation still referenced, has been released (Conversation.deinit calls litert_lm_conversation_delete).
